content:
sam-support: Hey team, ACME reported being charged twice for the same renewal window after they added a PO mid-cycle. Customer says one charge is via card and another invoice paid via PO — wants refund for the accidental auto-charge.

maya-billing: Ack, can you paste invoice IDs? I want to check if the system created both or if it retried.

sam-support: Invoice IDs from the customer: INV-2026-0893 (card) and INV-PO-0893 (PO). customer attached screenshots. They say PO was added after renewal but before payment processed.

maya-billing: Hmm—looks like our flow flagged subscription as paid_by_card when renewal fired, then when PO got attached later the billing job issued a separate invoice instead of associating with existing. Possible race between renewal job and PO link handler.

billing-bot: automated: invoice.created INV-2026-0893 user_id=acme_corp triggered_by=renewal-job run_id=rl-5463

billing-bot: automated: invoice.created INV-PO-0893 user_id=acme_corp triggered_by=po-attach-handler handler_id=ha-220

devon-finance: If both invoices were marked as 'paid' we need to issue reversal/credit for one and sync tax/VAT. Which one was charged to card?

sam-support: Card charge is INV-2026-0893. Customer confirms the card was charged and the PO invoice is still 'open' but shows as paid_by_po in their system. They want the card refund ASAP.

maya-billing: Repro steps I ran in sandbox: 1) create subscription, 2) enable auto-renew, 3) trigger renewal job, 4) attach PO during asynchronous webhook — saw two invoice.created events when PO attach callback happened within 30s of renewal. Code snippet of the handler below: 

```
// simplified pseudocode
onRenewal() { createInvoice(subscription, method=determinePaymentMethod()); }
onPoAttach() { if (!hasInvoiceForPeriod(subscription, period)) createInvoice(subscription, method='po'); else markInvoiceAsPaidByPO(existingInvoice); }
```

maya-billing: It looks like hasInvoiceForPeriod check races with renewal job. The renewal job creates invoice A, then PO attach handler doesn't find invoice yet (timing) so creates invoice B.

chris-ops: Quick mitigation: we can cancel invoice B (PO one) and link PO to invoice A in DB, then issue refund for invoice A charge. But need finance signoff for immediate refund. Also need to update webhook ordering or lock around invoice creation.

devon-finance: Approve refund for card charge INV-2026-0893. Please confirm amount and tax treatment — customer is EU VAT registered, they claimed reverse charge. Need to generate credit note.

sam-support: Amount is $3,200.00 USD, tax 0% per reverse-charge note customer provided. Customer expects refund to card and credit note for accounting.

maya-billing: I'll schedule a rollback job to consolidate invoices and issue credit note. Steps: 1) mark INV-PO-0893 as duplicate, 2) attach PO to INV-2026-0893 in metadata, 3) create credit_note CN-2026-045 for INV-2026-0893, 4) trigger refund to card. Please approve window: 15-30min ops work + refund propagation 3-5 business days.

chris-ops: @devon-finance please confirm we can void INV-PO-0893 and not trigger duplicate accounting entries. Also need tax code copy to include on credit note.

devon-finance: Confirmed. Void INV-PO-0893, issue CN-2026-045 referencing both invoices for audit trail, refund INV-2026-0893 charged amount. Include VAT reversal note referencing EU VAT ID from customer.

sam-support: Forwarded all approvals to customer: they asked for an ETA. I told them 24-48h for full reconciliation, refund may show sooner.

billing-bot: automated: credit_note.created CN-2026-045 amount=3200 currency=USD linked_invoices=INV-2026-0893,INV-PO-0893 created_by=maya-billing

billing-bot: automated: refund.initiated refund_id=rf-772 user=acme_corp invoice=INV-2026-0893 amount=3200 status=pending

maya-billing: Patch planned: add idempotency lock on (subscription_id, period) for invoice creation and make po-attach handler prefer linking instead of creating. Also add a short retry/backoff when checking hasInvoiceForPeriod to reduce races.

chris-ops: Nice. Can we add an audit log entry for this incident so CS has a single link to share with customer?

maya-billing: Done — internal audit ticket BI-2026-321 created and linked.

sam-support: Customer replied: "Thanks — we appreciate the quick action. Please send credit note for accounting asap." :thumbsup:

devon-finance: Once refund completes, I'll update accounting and send final receipt. Leaving open until refund confirmed.

sam-support: I'll follow up when refund transitions to completed. Closing here for now but keeping ticket open.

chris-ops: Follow-up action items: (1) deploy idempotency fix to billing worker, (2) add integration test that simulates concurrent PO attach + renewal, (3) retroactively scan last 7 days for similar pattern and create list.

maya-billing: I'll own (1) and (3). Sam will own (2) with dev QA.

sam-support: Thanks everyone.
